keyFindings.description: A lease holder whose receive (bus) connection alone is cut silently, its lease connection up, notices in about 2 s (#2542) and answers /healthz 503 'subscription inactive', but renew keeps renewing, so no standby takes over until self-health terminates the pod: the tester (round 17, https://github.com/sjawhar/legion/pull/2404#issuecomment-6535168335) measured the standby taking the lease 602.4 s after the cut, num_pending past 2,600, nothing delivered. Required: a holder that has not been receiving for a bound of a few seconds (the signal behind the 503) stops renewing and releases with no clean-hand-back mark, so a standby takes over and holds 7 s; a reconnect inside the bound keeps the lease; a pod that released for this reason does not take the lease again while its receive connection is still down, and stands by again once it is back. A two-pod row under the rendered grant that cuts only the receive connection must fail first (no take-over within 60 s today) and then show the standby delivering in order within 15 s of the cut, no bounce back while the cut lasts, and the pod standing by after it heals.
